mechanism: Enalapril may increase mefloquine levels by reducing renal clearance through ACE inhibition-induced hemodynamic changes, while mefloquine can cause dizziness and neuropsychiatric effects that may be potentiated by enalapril's hypotensive action.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess for CNS symptoms (dizziness, neuropsychiatric changes), and consider alternative antimalarial agents if possible; ensure adequate hydration and renal function monitoring.
